question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. **

Taut
solution: The correct answer is '**Slack**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Taut**' is '**Slack**'. • **Taut**: (used about rope, wire, etc.) stretched very tight; not loose. [(रस्‍सी, तार आदि) कसकर बाँधा गया; ढीला नहीं, कसा हुआ] • *Example: The skin of the drum is **taut**.* • **Slack**: loose; not tightly stretched. (शिथिल, ढीला; जो कसा हुआ न हो) • *Example: Leave the rope **slack**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Slack.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Tight**: fixed firmly in position and difficult to move or remove. [किसी स्‍थान पर कसकर बँधा हुआ (जिसका हिलना या जिसे हिलाना कठिन हो)] • **Solid**: hard and firm; not in the form of liquid or gas. (कड़ा और पक्‍का; द्रव या गैस नहीं, ठोस) • **Strong**: (used about a person) physically powerful; able to lift or carry heavy things. [(व्‍यक्ति) शरीर से ताक़तवर, बलवान, हष्‍ट-पुष्‍ट; वज़न उठाने या ले जाने में समर्थ] 3f:T907, The correct answer is** She said to me, "What is your favourite cuisine?"**
